title: Open an applet
summary: Opens one of the mChatAI applets on this device by name, such as AI Music, StoryMaker, AI News, Weather or AI Write.
whenToUse: Use only when the person asks to open, launch or go to an applet by its name.

arguments.name: applet
arguments.description: The applet's name as the person said it, such as StoryMaker or AI News

_note: Phase AV.20 (11-12): offered only when an applet's name is said; the flywheel's 'open source AI models' was offered it.
